author: Dygster
quote:
I really loved this one, the gameplay felt like a perfect mishmash of many previous Castlevania games, The whip traversal was taken from Super Castlevania IV, The Arcanum cards remind me of COTM, They brought back platforming from the Classic games (something i really appreciate after the Igavanias toned it down a lot) and The early exploration of the game was inspired by Order of Ecclesia. The relic system is simplified from the usual RPG bloat in Castlevania games like it was in Lament of Innocence, and the combat feels familiar to Curse of Darkness (specifically the forced closed-area enemy encounters and the weapon class system) if it was a 2.5D game instead of a 3D one. Also no spoilers but i found the story taking more narrative beats from Curse of Darkness and Lament of Innocence than it did from Castlevania III which suprised me considering how much the game was advertised as a sequel to Castlevania III mainly.

Honestly the only complaints i have is occasional stuttering during cutscenes and the music feeling too passive in some segments, not bad, but definitely could've been better (don't worry there are still some bangers though).

Anyhow if you play the game expecting a 1:1 copy of SOTN or something like the GBA/DS games, then it might not vibe with you much, however if you're a fan of the larger Castlevania series rather than just the Igavania formula then by all means do get it.
